title: fix: keep missing-usage errors from corrupting SSE
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Validates complete SSE events before forwarding them, so missing usage cannot splice an error into partial JSON.
- Shares the frame handling between Chat Completions and Responses without changing valid upstream bytes.
- Covers LF, CRLF, CR, UTF-8 byte splits, truncated JSON, and EOF-closed terminal events; fixes delayed CR validation found during review.
- Tests: 16 framing tests plus the existing text protocol regressions.

gist.headline: Streams keep their shape
gist.blurb: The hive learned to inspect each stream frame before passing it along. Missing usage data can no longer wander into the middle of an otherwise innocent JSON event.
gist.summary: Added shared SSE frame validation for Chat Completions and Responses streams, preserving valid upstream bytes while preventing missing-usage errors from being inserted into partial JSON across LF, CRLF, CR, UTF-8 split, truncated, and EOF-closed events.
gist.impact: Streaming clients now receive intact SSE events when usage data is absent, rather than a partial JSON payload spliced together with an error.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a careful stream gardener, checking individual glowing data droplets before they flow through a retro terminal's clear channel. A CRT robot watches intact JSON-shaped water frames travel safely past code-plants, while malformed fragments are gently caught in a small sieve rather than contaminating the stream.
